title: Hunts FH-036S: Wire the Experience Pass into ticket checkout and the organizer screen

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail: Call resolvePurchase from the Event ticket checkout for a bound tier (canonical price, snapshot stored with the ticket, return path from passReturnPath, huntSalesOpen checked before any session is created), add the organizer screen that writes a binding through validateBinding, and an admin toggle for the sales kill switch. Done when: through the real checkout a forged price, wrong tier and closed switch are refused, and the owner has a drill record of closing and reopening sales. Requires: FH-036, FH-040, FH-035. Owner role: Events and billing.
